story: [R00] Raid 1 — Encounter 5 begins.

[R01] Lyra MISTAKE · Minor · Started an Argument in Raid Chat
      "Lyra said one word about the healing and the fight has become a meeting."
[R01] Lyra drags Greg into it.

[R03] Lyra MISTAKE · Severe · Stood in the Fire (after g11:r1:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 1)
      "Lyra assumed somebody would say something, and they were all busy."
[R03] Bob steps out at 4 stacks; Dave takes over.
[R03] Lyra finally steps out of the fire.
[R04] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.

[R04] Dave MISTAKE · Moderate · Stood in the Fire
      "Dave is in the fire on purpose, briefly, for reasons Dave will explain later."

[R04] Bob MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt
      "Bob did taunt. Very quietly, and slightly too late, and while facing the wall."
[R05] Bob has lost Main Boss's attention; it swings at Dave first.
[R05] Main Boss turns on Dave.

[R05] Wanda MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Wanda was told to hold back until the tank had it, held back for one round, and decided that was long enough."

[R05] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after g01:r4:MIS_FIRE, depth 1)
      "Something has happened at Dave's house, and it is more interesting than this."
[R05] Dave has wandered off for three rounds.
[R06] Main Boss turns on Wanda.
[R06] Dave finally steps out of the fire.

[R06] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g01:r5:MIS_AFK, depth 2)
      "Natsuna has asked who is in charge here, which is a fair question, badly timed."
[R06] Natsuna drags Zed into it.

[R07] Cindy MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g01:r5:MIS_AFK, depth 2)
      "Cindy is saving the big heal for somebody who deserves it more, which is a philosophy, not a plan."
[R08] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.

[R08] Zed MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Zed has one spell that is far better than the others and has now cast it four times running."
[R09] Main Boss turns on Zed.
[R09] Dave taunts the boss back.

[R09] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Nobody asked Steve to go first, and nobody has ever needed to."
[R10] Main Boss turns on Steve.

[R10] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Bounced the Chain Heal Into Nobody (after g08:r9:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Natsuna healed one raider, then the wall, then the wall again."

[R11] Kel MISTAKE · Severe · Dropped a Mechanic
      "Kel put it down somewhere sensible, and sensible turned out to be where everybody was."
[R11] Kel finally steps out of the fire.
[R12] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.
[R12] Dave taunts the boss back.

[R12] Cindy MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g02:r7:MIS_HEAL_WRONG, depth 3)
      "Cindy healed the loudest raider rather than the quietest one, and the quiet one is the problem."
[R14] Main Boss turns on Dave.

[R14] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Greg opened at full strength on round one, because opening at half strength has never once felt good."
[R15] Dave steps out at 4 stacks; Bob takes over.
[R15] Main Boss turns on Bob.
[R15] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R15] Greg MISTAKE · Severe · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g05:r14:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Greg is being chased by something enormous and is telling everybody about it as it happens."

[R15] Greg MISTAKE · Minor · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g05:r15:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Greg corrected somebody's pronunciation of the boss's name and the room turned."
[R15] Greg drags Cindy into it.
[R16] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.
[R16] Main Boss turns on Greg.

[R16] Zed MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Somebody called a switch, and Zed switched to the thing they had just switched off."

[R16] Cindy MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g05:r15:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Cindy is defending a friend who has not asked to be defended, and is losing."
[R16] Cindy drags Pip into it.

[R16] Natsuna MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after g05:r15:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Natsuna is standing perfectly still with the calm of somebody who has gone to answer the door."
[R16] Natsuna has wandered off for three rounds.

[R17] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Steve was told to focus the marked one and has focused the one closest to being marked."

[R17] Zed MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g10:r16:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "The boss was busy with somebody else, which Zed read as an opportunity rather than as the plan working."

[R18] Kel MISTAKE · Minor · Stood in the Fire
      "Kel stepped out, then stepped back for the one item on the floor."
[R18] Main Boss turns on Zed.
[R18] Bob taunts the boss back.
[R18] Kel finally steps out of the fire.
[R20] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.

[R20] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Greg has been waiting all fight to do the thing, and the boss has now noticed Greg doing the thing."
[R21] Main Boss turns on Greg.
[R21] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R21] Greg MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target (after g05:r20:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Greg was already behind something, and moving would have wasted the position."

[R22] Lyra MISTAKE · Moderate · Dropped a Mechanic
      "Lyra was counting, lost count, and rounded down."
[R22] Main Boss turns on Bob.
[R22] Lyra finally steps out of the fire.
[R23] Bob steps out at 4 stacks; Dave takes over.
[R23] Dave taunts the boss back.
[R24] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.
[R24] Main Boss turns on Dave.

[R25] Greg MISTAKE · Severe · Died to Something Extremely Avoidable (after g05:r21:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 2)
      "Greg went down to something small, slow and clearly signposted."
[R25] Greg is DEAD.

[R25] Pip MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Pip heard 'left' and, from where Pip was standing, was entirely correct."

[R26] Lyra MISTAKE · Moderate · Stood in the Fire
      "Lyra was following the person in front, who was also wrong."
[R26] Dave steps out at 4 stacks; Bob takes over.
[R26] Lyra finally steps out of the fire.
[R26] Raid 1 — Encounter 5 is defeated.
why: The fight that actually happens: Boss 5 in Boss 1-4 gear, which docs/08 §9.2 sizes for 22 rounds. The tier's real difficulty check.
